summary: Gordon accepted the bounded macOS feasibility direction after independent review. The 47-case native gate passes. Known fidelity gaps and production/platform acceptance are tracked in linked follow-up issues.
reviewLimits: Reviewer ran its own native fixtures and checked hashes, but did not rebuild or rerun the complete gate. This is a model review of macOS feasibility, not production acceptance or an audit.
knownDivergences: Scrolled-off Kitty placement records are lost by the importer although cached pixels remain.
Virtual and parent/relative Kitty placements can diverge and are not exhaustively rejected.
A full 20-column line followed by carriage return and shrink to 10 columns has a native engine cell difference.
acceptanceLimits: Only the default native view geometry was validated.
PTY routing is imposed by the harness; production client reply suppression/enforcement remains open.
Multi-Mac, iPhone/iPad integration, native Linux/Windows, resource budgets, error contracts and full graphics behavior remain unvalidated.
